evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: Inspired by recent papers on Agentic Robotics, where pretrained LLM and VLM coding agents combine interpretable robot programming with the open-world adaptability of model free policies, we propose a general set of agentic robotics benchmark design criteria that includes accessibility, repeatability, diversity, relevance to agentic robotics and practical applications, physical realizability, resistance to benchmark saturation, and computational efficiency.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: For robots to operate reliably in commercial and industrial applications, they must persistently perform specific tasks with known variations in object shape and pose.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Built fully on open-source tools, VABAR features detailed implementations using the Newton physics engine, standardized task variations, difficulty tiers, success metrics, and a library of 33 generalizable skills with human-authored programmatic reference solutions.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We provide initial baseline evaluations using an open agentic manipulation harness, Graph-as-Policy (GaP), and Isaac Lab Arena.
